about: AutoPipeline's first run for docs/autopipeline/guide.md: the released 0.1.5 package's synthetic demo, its monitor in text and its status. The output lines were captured from real runs on 21 October 2026 in a Claude cloud container (Python 3.13); the package folder is shortened to $AP_DIR. Synthetic data and stand-in VC3D tools and ink model.
